# Agent plugins

Plugins for Claude Code and Codex. Each plugin passes a security gate before release and lists the harnesses and models it was tested on, the permissions it needs and what it must be installed with.

## Plugins

| Plugin | What it does | Claude Code | Codex | Tested models | Permissions | Needs | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [docs-index](docs/plugins/docs-index.md) | Keeps a project's docs/ tree with a one-line-summary INDEX.md and an MLA BIBLIOGRAPHY.md with cited-by links. | ✅ | ◐ No Stop hook; Codex follows the AGENTS.md block and runs the docs-index CLI. | untested | `Read`, `Glob`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/docs_index.py" *)` | — | active |
| [session-checkpoint](docs/plugins/session-checkpoint.md) | Proves before a restart that everything the owner said and the session produced is saved where the next session reads. | ✅ | — Reads Claude Code transcripts and dispatches a Claude Code sub-agent. | untested | `Read`, `Grep`, `Glob`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Agent`, `Bash(python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/session-checkpoint/extract.py *)`, `Bash(git add *)`, `Bash(git commit *)` | — | active |
| [ui-design-process](docs/plugins/ui-design-process.md) | Agent-run UI design with competing designer personas, critique, audits, judging, fusion and a studio page. | ✅ | — Needs the Claude Code Workflow tool. | untested | `Read`, `Write`, `Workflow`, `Agent`, `Artifact`, `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `network` | — | active |
| [word-codes](docs/plugins/word-codes.md) | Adjective-animal codes read on one screen and typed or compared on another, with the shared lists and module. | ✅ | ✅ | untested | `Read`, `Bash(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/word-codes/test_wordcode.py")`, `Bash(cp ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/word-codes/* *)` | — | active |

Certified models: claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, codex-default. Full history: [MODEL-TESTED-VERSIONS.md](docs/MODEL-TESTED-VERSIONS.md).

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add stegbk/agent-plugins
/plugin install <plugin>@agent-plugins
```

Codex:

```
codex plugin marketplace add stegbk/agent-plugins
codex plugin add <plugin>@agent-plugins
```

## Security

Every plugin passes a security gate before release and is re-checked daily. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) to report a problem.
